:::{#exr-linear-map-zero-practice}
#### Ruling out a linear map from its value at zero

@thm-linear-map-zero gives a quick test:
a [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) that does not send $\vzero$ to $\vzero$ cannot be a [linear map](#def-linear-map).
Let $g: \reals^2 \to \reals^2$ be

$$
g(\vx) = (x_1 + x_2,\ x_2 - 1).
$$

Is $g$ a [linear map](#def-linear-map)?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Compute $g(\vzero)$.

:::

:::
